purpose: Stage 1B access/license manifest for the five candidate datasets. No credentials stored anywhere in this file or repository.

GalaxyPPG.license: CC BY 4.0 (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International), per Zenodo record and Scientific Data paper
GalaxyPPG.download_note: Direct curl/HTTP access to zenodo.org timed out repeatedly from this sandbox's network egress during this sprint (verified: two independent 15-20s timeouts to zenodo.org/records/* and zenodo.org/api/records/*). Dataset facts were instead verified via the peer-reviewed Scientific Data paper's own reported MEASURED (not nominal) sample rates and per-participant completeness table (PMC12119839), which is authoritative-source verification per Section 8's priority order, but is not the same as this session directly listing/hashing the Zenodo files.
GalaxyPPG.redistribution_limits: CC BY permits redistribution with attribution; raw files still should not be committed to this repo (size, license-attribution-per-file bookkeeping burden) - same policy as every other dataset in this project.
GalaxyPPG.total_size_estimate: Not stated in source; 24 participants x multiple ~10-15 min sessions x 3 CSV streams each - LOW-to-MEDIUM by file count, small by bytes (CSV, not raw waveform binary).

HMC.download_state: PARTIAL - RECORDS index and dataset description fetched and read this sprint; individual .edf recordings not downloaded (151 recordings x ~100MB would be a multi-GB fetch, deferred to Stage 2 per Section 9's 'representative subset' allowance).
HMC.redistribution_limits: CC BY permits redistribution with attribution.
HMC.total_size_estimate: 15.7 GB uncompressed / 12.9 GB compressed ZIP, per PhysioNet's own stated total (authoritative source, not inferred).

QDE_V2.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
QDE_V2.source_location: https://physionet.org/content/qde/1.0.0/ (already downloaded in a prior sprint: datasets/qde-bioimpedance/raw/dehydration_estimation.csv)
QDE_V2.raw_data_committed_note: The CSV already exists locally under datasets/qde-bioimpedance/raw/ (gitignored per project convention, same as every other raw dataset file) - not newly added by this sprint.
QDE_V2.total_size_estimate: ~14 KB, 90 rows - directly measured this sprint (`ls -la`).

LBNP.license: Not explicitly stated in the PMC data-availability text retrieved this sprint - Zenodo record metadata (license field) could not be read this sprint (see download_note); treat as UNVERIFIED pending direct Zenodo access.
LBNP.authentication_required: UNVERIFIED (paper states data 'have been made into an open-source data set', implying no authentication, but this session could not directly confirm via the Zenodo page itself)
LBNP.source_location: Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10119427 (per the paper's own Data Availability statement, PMC11018605)
LBNP.download_note: Same zenodo.org network-egress timeout as GalaxyPPG (see above) prevented this session from directly browsing/downloading the LBNP raw files or reading the Zenodo record's own license/access metadata. All LBNP facts in this sprint's audit come from the peer-reviewed paper's Methods and Data Availability sections (PMC11018605), which is a real, authoritative, directly-fetched source - but is one level removed from the raw files themselves.
LBNP.total_size_estimate: UNVERIFIED (18 enrolled / 16 usable subjects, multi-modal continuous recording of unspecified individual file sizes)

ds003838.license: CC0, per dataset_description.json (directly fetched and read this sprint)
ds003838.source_location: https://openneuro.org/datasets/ds003838 (GitHub mirror directly fetched this sprint: https://github.com/OpenNeuroDatasets/ds003838, a DataLad/git-annex repository)
ds003838.file_format: BIDS; EEG stored as single-file .set (EEGLAB, raw continuous data embedded, not split into companion .fdt - confirmed by directly fetching one real channels.tsv/eeg.json/participants.tsv and the git-annex object size for one representative subject's .set files this sprint)
ds003838.download_state: PARTIAL - participants.tsv, dataset_description.json, one representative subject's (sub-032) channels.tsv/eeg.json/events.json, and the full repository file tree (2696 entries) were directly fetched and read this sprint. No actual EEG waveform bytes were downloaded (git-annex pointer files only - the real binary content lives in an annex remote, not directly fetchable via raw.githubusercontent.com).
ds003838.total_size_estimate: Directly measured via git-annex object pointer sizes this sprint: sub-032 memory-task .set = 1,541,437,462 bytes (~1.47 GiB), rest-task .set = 47,511,267 bytes (~45 MiB). 65 usable-EEG subjects x (~1.47 GiB + ~45 MiB) is approximately 96-99 GB for full EEG-only download (both tasks) - real, measured, not the prior audit's ~250 GB guess (that figure likely included non-EEG modalities/other file types or was a rough overestimate; this sprint's number is the directly-measured EEG-only figure).
